Name: Gluttony Combo
Description: Gluttony Combo - lalalazy fork of Gluttony Combo. XIVCombo for very lazy players.
Punchline: Lalalazy fork of Wrath Combo - XIVCombo for very lazy players.
Changelog:
v1.0.4.97 - Merged upstream Wrath Combo 1.0.4.19
- Upstream job-rotation updates across SAM, NIN, MNK, MCH, RPR, DRG, BLM, VPR, SGE and WHM (Samurai and Ninja got the biggest reworks: Throwing Daggers / Fleeting Raiju handling and opener fixes).
- Item usage is now attributed to the correct player, and the weave / "GCDs used" checks were reworked to read action history more robustly.
- Action-sheet lookups are hardened so an unknown action ID can no longer throw.
- All GluttonyCombo customizations preserved: Amnesia / Pacification / Silence handling, 15s raidwide-mitigation gate + raidwide cast-bar timer, WHM ground-heal targeting, SMN Aegis Uptime, BLU autorotation engine, and OccultCrescent phantom-job buffs.
